_comment: Anchors are STRUCTURAL spans (row357): the value-bearing text of each decision -- the quotes, the False -- sits in the zero-width lookarounds, and the span is the identifier or the guard the decision is made with. Each mutant restores the pre-cut hazard at exactly one seam. The PUT fallback (app_sites_id_core api_update) is NOT scored here: measured pairwise it is an EQUIVALENT mutant, masked by the spawner it delegates to, which also defaults False. It is pinned by test_put_without_the_key_does_not_respawn_a_keeper as defence-in-depth.
subject: an automatic login is opt-in at every keep-alive seam: the site-config DEFAULTS, the keeper's own fallback, the spawner's gate, the manual-login profile seed, and the clone strip set

mutants.label: the DEFAULTS entry stops governing a newly minted or reloaded site
the keeper's own guard stops disabling a config that omits the key
the spawner's gate stops skipping a config that omits the key
finish_manual_login seeds a keepalive profile for a config that omits the key
the clone strip set stops removing the parent's opt-in
